Your task is to design and architect a complete intelligent web application called EcoMed, a plant-health and disease-diagnosis platform.

Build EcoMed from the ground up in one complete response.

🔹 CORE VISION

EcoMed’s mission is to help anyone — students, families, elderly users, and farmers — easily understand plant health, detect diseases, and receive treatment guidance using AI.

The app must feel like having a personal plant doctor.

🔹 REQUIRED OUTPUT (in order)
1. Product Foundation

• Problem statement
• Target users
• Core value proposition
• Real-world impact

2. Features & System Design

Design EcoMed as a full platform including:
• Image-based disease detection
• Live AI Plant Doctor (real-time camera diagnosis like a doctor visit)
• Voice and multilingual interaction
• Elderly-friendly and low-literacy usability
• Plant health history and smart reminders
• Offline/lightweight mode
• Community or school use features

3. AI & Technical Architecture

• How Gemini API is used
• Model workflow (image → detection → confidence → explanation → solution)
• Real-time video processing for live sessions
• Browser-based optimization
• Privacy, safety, and performance design

4. UI/UX & Design System

• Flashy but classy premium UI concept
• Light mode & dark mode system
• Screen-by-screen layout (Home, Scan, Live Doctor, Results, History)
• Accessibility for elderly and non-English users
• Animations, micro-interactions, emotional design

5. Development Blueprint

• Frontend stack
• Backend stack
• AI integration flow
• APIs and services
• Deployment strategy

6. User Journey

Show the full flow from opening the app → scanning a plant → live session → receiving diagnosis → saving plant → long-term tracking.

7. Innovation Layer

Propose advanced ideas such as:
• Predictive plant health
• Disease outbreak mapping
• Smart agriculture integrations
• School and community dashboards
• Future IoT or drone support

8. Roadmap & Vision

• MVP stage
• Advanced version
• Global impact version
• 5-year vision

🔹 DESIGN RULES

• Premium but simple
• High-impact, real-world focused
• Inclusive and accessible
• Technically realistic
• Innovation-driven

Think like you are building a product meant to be presented to judges, parents, investors, and real users.”
